rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The Parliamentary Board, the Central Office Bearers and the Chief Ministers of BJP-ruled States met on 8 June 2005 'to discuss the resignation submitted by Shri L.K. Advaniji', with Shri M. Venkaiah Naidu presiding; 'The meeting unequivocally rejected the resignation' and appealed to Shri Advani 'to continue to lead the party'.
